title: rosa coriifolia cinerea
intro: Rosa coriifolia cinerea, commonly known as Himalayan rose, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects that provide various health benefits, such as wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support. The therapeutic actions of Rosa coriifolia cinerea include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which can help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and calm muscle spasms. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
